summary: Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing a press release dated September 30, 2026 announcing intent to commence a new buyback of up to C$10 billion of common shares, capped at 61 million shares, subject to OSFI approval, to be completed by July 2027. It follows completion of C$7 billion (47.2 million shares) under the existing TSX normal course issuer bid. The program equals 3.74% of 1,633,130,726 shares outstanding as of August 31, 2026; purchases will be cancelled. Watch regulatory approval timing and CET1 impact.
